kicker: A shooter in a real repo
title: Git Recon
lede: A codebase on real ground. Climb from the kitchen floor to the heights: win a mission to open the next.
touchHint: On a touch screen: the left stick moves, drag anywhere else to aim, and the buttons on the right fire, jump, dive-roll, crouch, reload, swap guns and step the rebase scope in and out. Tap the prompt by the crosshair to get in a vehicle or open the parachute.
